IN MORE DETAIL

Choosing IT services around business needs

A direct business customer may need support for a single problem or a broader improvement programme. HeyDock’s service model covers people, infrastructure, software and automation, allowing the work to be scoped around the operational issue. The first step is to identify the affected team and the result that would make the engagement successful.

An office may need reliable device onboarding and collaboration tools. A service business may need booking, appointment or ticketing workflows. A growing operation may need an ERP implementation or an integration between existing systems. These are examples of requirements to discuss, not claims of completed sector-specific projects.

Where several services are involved, define ownership across them. A new application may depend on network access, data migration and staff training. A customer-support chatbot may depend on an accurate knowledge base and a human escalation route. A joined-up plan makes those dependencies visible before delivery starts.
